### Added
- **The model-serving cache outlives a pool teardown, its claim gets a fast StorageClass by default, and vLLM's compile cache lives on the claim** (giantswarm/agent-platform#537). Measured on a GPU pool scaling from zero: every new pool downloaded the weights again (the Helm-owned serving namespace took the kept `hf-cache` claim down with it on uninstall), the weights loaded at the default `gp3` baseline (8.8 GiB in 71 s = 124 MiB/s, the class's cap), and `torch.compile` ran on every pod (its cache in an emptyDir). The connectivity chart now: (1) marks the serving namespace `helm.sh/resource-policy: keep` while `modelServing.cache.enabled` is on — an uninstall leaves the namespace, the claim and its volume behind, nothing else; a re-install adopts them; (2) renders a StorageClass of the claim's own (`modelServing.cache.storageClass`, default `create: true`: `<chart>-<claim>` = `agent-platform-connectivity-hf-cache`, `provisioner: ebs.csi.aws.com`, `gp3` at `throughput: "1000"` / `iops: "4000"`, `WaitForFirstConsumer`, expansion allowed, `reclaimPolicy: Delete` — the claim is the durable object) and the applied claim references it; `create: false` with `name` references an existing class and renders none; `pvc.storageClassName` next to `create: true` is refused naming both; the default is AWS's, another cloud sets `provisioner` and `parameters`; (3) adds `VLLM_CACHE_ROOT=/mnt/models/.cache/vllm` to `modelServing.policies.env` and mounts the runtime container's `/mnt/models` read-write in both pod shapes, so a model's compiled graphs persist in its cache directory. The meta chart mirrors every new default; `tests/verify-mirrored-values.py` now holds the whole `modelServing.cache` and `modelServing.policies` blocks equal between the charts (a forwarded `env` without the entry would drop it from every installation), with a second negative control in `make verify-meta`. An installation whose claim already exists on another class keeps it with `storageClass.create: false` and `name: <its class>` (`storageClassName` is immutable; the hook fails naming the field otherwise).
